title: How the band and the name Kid Thomas came about
summary: An old bass player named the band after asking each member's name; Thomas stayed 'Kid' and few people know his real name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah, sure, you see, I'm gonna tell you how they named this band. Yeah. You see, when I first came here, this old man, he's the oldest one in the band, they're the bass, so we gonna get a name for the band, you know what I mean? The band ain't no name. Yeah. So he asked everybody in the band what their name. Yeah. Oh, he said, oh, them names don't fit. So he asked, he said, son, I was young then, you know, he said, son, what's your name? I said, my name's Thomas. He said, that's the one, Kid Thomas. Yeah? He named the band there, the old man. And that's how you got to be called Kid? Yeah, yeah, he's the one. Mm-hmm.

And people be surprised, they say, man, I didn't know you only did this. You know what I mean? All them years, you know what I'm talking about? No, I never did, they never know.
